title: feat(i18n): publish TranslateFn as the one authority; app-shell and fields re-export it (objectui#8261)
body:
Fixes #8261
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/i18n` publishes a new name, `TranslateFn`

Executes the maintainer's ruling on objectui#8165 (comment 5565867673, decision batch #72, option A): the narrowed i18next `t` gets ONE authority, exported from `@object-ui/i18n`, and the two remaining declarations become type re-exports of it. All gates below were run at head `367e586e4`.

Spelling note: GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments from bodies, so the options parameter's type is written `Record(string, unknown)` here; the source spells it with angle brackets.

## What changed

- `packages/i18n/src/translateFn.ts` (new): `export type TranslateFn = (key: string, options?: Record(string, unknown)) => string;` with a docblock naming it the one authority.
- `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`: `export type { TranslateFn } from './translateFn.js';`, next to the existing `SafeTranslate` export.
- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` and `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts`: the local declaration is gone. Each now does `import type { TranslateFn } from '@object-ui/i18n'` for its own uses and `export type { TranslateFn } from '@object-ui/i18n'`, so every existing import of the name from these two modules still resolves. From `writeWarningToast` that is `AdapterProvider`; from `file-size-guard` it is `FileField`, `ImageField`, `LocationField` and `numberBadInput`. None of their import paths change.
- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts` and `metadataReadWarningToast.ts` now re-export from `@object-ui/i18n` directly, not through `writeWarningToast`. Their docblocks said `writeWarningToast` was the owner, which this change makes false, so they had to be rewritten anyway. Pointing them at the real owner means an import resolves in one hop and no module in the chain claims ownership it lacks.
- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts`: its local, unexported `type TranslateFn` is replaced by `import type { TranslateFn } from '@object-ui/i18n'` (see H1).
- `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: the `TranslateFn` row is removed from `KNOWN_COLLISIONS`. Its comment block is replaced by a "sat here" note in the form the other retired rows use. No line was added.
- `.changeset/8261-translatefn-i18n-authority.md`: `'@object-ui/i18n': minor` (a newly published name), `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, `'@object-ui/fields': patch`. No `major`.
- `.changeset/8165-translatefn-one-authority.md`: prose reconciled with a dated note (H6). The frontmatter is byte-identical.
- `packages/i18n/README.md`: a short `TranslateFn` subsection (H6).

## H1: census on the base (`c659439b4`)

`TranslateFn` declarations:

| site | exported? | seen by the one-authority gate? |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` | yes | yes (the gate's row) |
| `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts` | yes | yes (the gate's row) |
| `packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` | no | no |
| `packages/app-shell/src/utils/managedByEmptyState.ts` | no | no |

`saveAdvisoryToast.ts` and `metadataReadWarningToast.ts` re-exported the name from `writeWarningToast`, as the order stated.

Neither local declaration is visible to the gate. Its `DECLARATION` pattern needs a leading `export`, and it counts exported type-level names only (bound 1 in its header). Both local declarations are rows in objectui#8203's table.

- **`usePublishAllDrafts.ts` is re-pointed.** It is in this order's file surface. The order also asked whether it is identical in shape. It is identical in type, but not byte-identical: the parameter is spelled `opts`. TypeScript does not compare parameter names when it checks a function type, so the signature of `usePublishAllDrafts(t: TranslateFn)` is unchanged. `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` pins the text `export function usePublishAllDrafts(t: TranslateFn)`, which is kept.
- **`managedByEmptyState.ts` is NOT touched.** It is byte-identical to the ruled shape, but it is outside the claim's file surface and the order's. It is recorded under Acceptance notes.

The same shape under other names on the base: `TranslationFn` (AiChatPage), `TFn` (CloudAiModelStatus), `OrgTranslate` (exported), `Translate` (`packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts`), `InboxTranslate` (exported), `ActivityTranslate`, `CommentsTranslate`, `SummaryTranslate` and `TimelineTranslate` (exported). Some spell the second parameter `vars` or `params`. These are objectui#8203's population. objectui#8203 is closed `not_planned` and is not addressed here.

## H2: byte-identity, re-measured before re-pointing

On `c659439b4`, the two exported declarations are the same line:

```
export type TranslateFn = (key: string, options?: Record(string, unknown)) => string;
sha256 29f2f334f47b8ac55bd05fc5dcf7f0d769c303f0e2deb1c79aff6a9cd46e3762  (both lines, trailing newline included: 86 bytes)
sha256 1a7e8e9dd0c69e6cfb4e6ccff472df17d878277ef4eafb907fbb018d6600e2b2  (both, without the newline: 85 bytes)
cmp exit 0; identical od -c dumps
```

This matches the card's `29f2f334…`, 86 bytes on `158d75bb3`, so nothing has drifted. The new declaration in `@object-ui/i18n` is the same line, so re-pointing changes no call site's contract.

## H3: the home

- `@object-ui/i18n`'s `package.json` declares `types` and `exports['.'].types` as `./dist/index.d.ts`. `tsconfig.json` sets `rootDir: src`, so the entry file is `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`. The package has no stale second entry.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/fields` both already list `@object-ui/i18n: workspace:*` in `dependencies`. `@object-ui/i18n`'s only workspace dependency is `@object-ui/core`, which depends only on `@object-ui/types`, so there is no cycle. **No `package.json` changed.**
- Built declaration, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28/28 successful):

| file | `TranslateFn` | control |
| :-- | --: | :-- |
| `packages/i18n/dist/index.d.ts` | 1: `export type { TranslateFn } from './translateFn.js';` | `SafeTranslate` 2 |
| `packages/i18n/dist/translateFn.d.ts` | 3 (the declaration plus two docblock mentions) | n/a |
| `packages/fields/dist/index.d.ts` | **0**: the name is not on `@object-ui/fields`' face | `FileField` 2 |

## H5: the gate, before and after, plus ablation

| run | tree | result |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| gate BEFORE | detached worktree at `c659439b4` (`TranslateFn` rows: 1) | Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 11 passed (11) |
| gate AFTER | head `367e586e4` (`TranslateFn` rows: 0) | Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 11 passed (11) |

Ablation was run at `367e586e4` after the commit. Every leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) in wrap mode: the anchor had to hit exactly once, the blob change was checked on disk, and the file was restored from `HEAD`. The gate reads source from disk, so no build or `dist` is involved in legs A and B.

- **Leg A: a local declaration put back in `file-size-guard.ts`.** The re-export line was replaced by the old declaration: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `ca873659cf07` to `6e625184bee3`. Gate exit 1 (Tests 1 failed, 10 passed). The collision is named:
  ```
  TranslateFn — a NEW colliding name
      packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts — type declaration
      packages/i18n/src/translateFn.ts — type declaration
  ⛔ KNOWN_COLLISIONS is SHRINK-ONLY: adding a line is not a supported way …
  ```
- **Leg B: the removed row put back, re-points kept.** This is the stale-row direction, modelled on #8205's leg B. The mutation was 0 rows to 1, blob `600bed9be040` to `38991d28dc31`. Gate exit 1 (Tests 1 failed, 10 passed), which proves the row removal was owed:
  ```
  KNOWN_COLLISIONS lists collisions that no longer exist …
    TranslateFn — no longer collides at:
        packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts
        packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts
  ```
- **Leg C: type reverse-verification of the rebuilt `.d.ts`.** A probe `export const typeProbe8261: TranslateFn = (key: number) => String(key);` was planted in `file-size-guard.ts`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields exec tsc --noEmit` was run. Exit 1 with exactly one error, `error TS2322: Type '(key: number) => string' is not assignable to type 'TranslateFn'.` This shows that the type `fields` resolves from `@object-ui/i18n` is the real narrowed shape, not an `any` from an unresolved or stale declaration.
- **Restore, proven by state.** Both paths ended with disk blob equal to the `HEAD` blob: `ca873659cf07…` for `file-size-guard.ts` and `600bed9be040…` for the gate. `git diff HEAD` was empty. After the run: declarations 0, re-export 1, rows 0.

## H6: published prose

- **`packages/i18n/README.md`** did not list the package's exported types; its API section documents functions. Per AGENTS.md commandment #2, it gains a short `### TranslateFn — typing a t you are handed` subsection with one `ts` snippet.
  - `check:readme-exports` judges `TranslateFn` as `real` from `@object-ui/i18n`.
  - The snippet was also compiled standalone with `tsc --strict` against the built `packages/i18n/dist/index.d.ts`: exit 0. A negative control changing `t('common.save')` to `t(42)` gave exit 2 with TS2345.
- **Pending changesets.** `git grep -l TranslateFn c659439b4 -- .changeset` finds one file, `.changeset/8165-translatefn-one-authority.md`. This change makes two of its sentences false: that `writeWarningToast` is the one authority, and that the name is on no package's published face. Following the objectui#10533 form:
  - both sentences are now scoped "at this change";
  - a `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-25 — the one authority has since moved to @object-ui/i18n — objectui#8261.**` paragraph follows them;
  - the frontmatter is unchanged: lines 1–2 have md5 `2ee28f1e1b449ccc2dd97fdcc6c2bc1f` before and after.
- `check:changeset-claims` lists three other pending bodies that name a file this change touches: `6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-1`, `8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud` and `9615-locale-count-ten`. I read all three and none is falsified. Each describes its own change, and the README heading `8632` cites still exists.

## Tests and gates (all at `367e586e4`)

Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and the verdicts are its own `VERDICT` lines. Timings are shared-box seconds.

| run | result |
| :-- | :-- |
| `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` | 28 successful, 28 total; `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` | exit 0, zero `error TS` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` | exit 0, zero `error TS` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` | exit 0, zero `error TS` |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` (covers the gate file) | exit 0, zero `error TS` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run` over the gate, `packages/i18n/`, app-shell `providers/`, `preview/`, `console/home/__tests__/`, `MetadataService.saveAdvisories`, `useMetadataClient.advisorySink`, and the 28 fields test files naming a `file-size-guard` consumer | **Test Files 149 passed (149), Tests 2616 passed (2616)**; `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0: 7 source files of 3 released packages changed, 1 changeset added |
| `check-changeset-no-major` / `check-changeset-fixed` | exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check-changeset-overwrite` | exit 0. Report-only; it reports the `8165` edit as its case 2 ("correcting … on purpose"), and both sides declare nothing |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | OK (8784 tracked text files) |
| `check:doc-fences` / `docs:check-links` / `check:readme-exports` | exit 0 / exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check:phantom-deps` / `check:unused-deps` / `check:unreferenced-sources` | exit 0 / exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` / `check:i18n-keys` / `check:esm-specifiers` | exit 0 / exit 0 / exit 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 11 changed paths | NOT GOVERNED |
| `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 8 changed source files | 8 files, 0 errors, 3 warnings. All 3 are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `usePublishAllDrafts.ts`; the base file has the same 3 |

**Declared narrowings**, so what was left out is visible:

- **Tests are targeted, not whole packages.** The change is type-only (`import type` / `export type` erase at build). The full app-shell and fields suites are CI's.
- **Lint ran on the 8 changed files, not the repository.** The file count comes from eslint's own JSON. `eslint.config.js` has no type-aware linting: no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`, and a control grep for `typescript-eslint` in the same file fires. So this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **`check:doc-snippets` was NOT MEASURED locally.** It needs almost the whole workspace built. The README snippet was instead compiled standalone against the built `.d.ts`, with a negative control, as shown under H6.
- **`check:readme-exports` saw 8 packages unbuilt.** Their rows are unjudged locally. The `@object-ui/i18n` rows, including `TranslateFn`, were judged.
- **Main has moved to `69a6fc1ce`.** `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 69a6fc1ce` is clean. None of the 139 paths main changed since `c659439b4` is among this branch's 11, and main's diff carries zero `TranslateFn` lines. So no merge commit was made.

## Acceptance notes

- **`packages/app-shell/src/utils/managedByEmptyState.ts` keeps a local, unexported `type TranslateFn`** that is byte-identical to the new authority. The gate cannot see it, and it is outside this dispatch's file surface. The one-line remedy is `import type { TranslateFn } from '@object-ui/i18n'`. Carrier: none (objectui#8203 is closed `not_planned`).
- **For whoever takes up objectui#8203's population:** `packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts` `Translate` can never point at `@object-ui/i18n`, because `@object-ui/i18n` depends on `@object-ui/core`.
- **Labels:** the card says the landing PR carries `needs:contract-review`. This dispatch allowed no label write beyond the PR assignee, so that label is left for the seat.
- objectui#8165: its `fields` half is done by construction here. The ruling comment says that card closes on the gate's reading of the `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` entry, so objectui#8165 remains open for the seat to close.

⛔ Left as **draft** on purpose: the seat flips it after review.
